relationships.subject: Locus coeruleus degeneration
relationships.evidence_quote: The loss of catecholaminergic regulation contributes to dysfunction in memory processes along with impaired functions associated with attention and task completion.

relationships.subject: D1/5 receptor antagonist
relationships.evidence_quote: Application of a D1/5 receptor antagonist in the dorsal hippocampus or medial PFC resulted in impairments of object recognition memory

key_findings: Review: LC NE/DA co-release regulates hippocampal LTP/LTD and memory; LC degeneration in AD contributes to memory dysfunction.
